design.baseline: Establish a local application boundary and existing conventions before choosing files or dependencies.
design.model: Run-scoped OrchestrationRun owns TaskNode, SkillInvocation, Attempt, and TelemetryEvent records. All 14 catalog skills remain metadata and are enumerated by the fixture; executed skill invocations map to logical task leaves. Pure selectors derive task, invocation, and leaf-only orchestrator projections.
design.persistence: A client-only normalized SQLite adapter stores run metadata and child records transactionally, with schema versioning, integrity checks, expected-version conflicts, and in-memory fallback.
design.ui: The primary surface presents aggregate progress, task hierarchy, active invocations, attempts, telemetry, and existing stage context with visible status text and responsive semantics.
design.verification: Tests prove model and persistence invariants; build/type checks prove repository integration; browser checks prove only observed UI behavior.
